profile.headline: Sr Software Engineer
profile.summary: I am passionate about programming, to create Graphic User Interface for desk top application or enhance  Web  user experiences. I also worked on backend library, server, window service. Besides C++, I also used Java, Java Script, Python, HTML, XML, QML.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description: Writing QML, java script and C++ code for embedded GUI on Ubuntu Linus, with elements such as scroll bar, Grid View, List View, image zooming and panning, drag and drop.

positions.title: Sr Software Engineer
positions.description:
。Modify GUI track simulation software according to LINK 16/11 specification.
。Port window software components to Linux.
。Environment: C++, Visual Studio 2010/2017, win7, win10, Eclipse, Linux

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
。Architect and implemented bitmap based dialog box classes for GUI.
。Developed FPGA library to interface with FPGA firmware for data acquisition.
。Developed sensor algorithm to interface with incoming hardware signals.
。Designed and implemented window service for file system clean up in Python.
。Environment: C++, Visual Studio, Python, XML, SDK, SVN, UNIX

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and implement GUI and simulation module for various large scale projects, using Object Oriented Design and Analysis, Design Pattern  with C++, STL, Rational Rose, UML, Clear Case,  Eclipse. on Linux and Solaris system.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Coded in C++ SQL call to access Oracle data base. Maintained, enhanced, and trouble shoot Javascript web based GUI for Personnel Management System with Oracle DB.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Design and implement GUI front end software using Visual C++ for video conference and data conference system.  With in depth knowledge in MFC for desktop GUI application and web applicatiion using ATL, COM, ASP, HTML, and Java Script.
